mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over the preceding three months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25% per month for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below zero at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly unemployment rate below 3.5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately compressing profit margins and resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate revenue prospects and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below zero at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly decline in both real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based weakening in demand, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline month-over-month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not significantly below zero at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly CPI inflation above 3% for four consecutive months, combined with a federal funds rate below 2%, signals a delayed monetary policy response, which erodes real equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3% for 4 consecutive months AND FEDFUNDS < 2%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below zero at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) acceleration above 0.5% after three months of stagnation (<0.1% growth) signals labor market recovery, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly change < 0.1% for 3 months, then > 0.5% in the next month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not significantly above zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.4% signals a synchronized expansion in demand and supply, which boosts earnings expectations and results in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both rise by > 0.4% month-over-month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not significantly above zero at 95% confidence.
